department: Department of Biostatistics and Bioinformatics, Rollins School of Public Health

deadline.value: Biostatistics application deadline for Fall 2027 is December 1, 2026. Rollins's international page also gives a May 1 preferred date for international students.

also.quote: The preferred application deadline for international students is May 1.

gre_general.value: The Biostatistics PhD lists GRE scores as optional.

gre_subject.value: No subject test is mentioned for biostatistics.

toefl_min.value: Rollins sets TOEFL iBT 4 (new scale) for tests taken after 21 January 2026; older scores were 79-80.

english_waiver.value: A degree taught in English from a foreign institution does not waive the test here, so Indian applicants need TOEFL or IELTS.
english_waiver.quote: Degrees from a foreign institution taught in English cannot be used to waive out of the requirement.

supervisor.value: Applicants are told to review faculty interest areas, but the page does not say contact is needed before admission.

funding.value: All full-time PhD students get a tuition scholarship and stipend for five years, if in good standing.
funding.quote: All full-time Emory PhD students receive a generous financial support package from the Laney Graduate School

entry_route.value: The page says a master's in biostatistics or statistics gives exemption from some courses, but does not say whether a bachelor's alone is enough.

notes: Rollins School of Public Health, PhD applications through Laney. Override fields (gre_general, toefl_min, ielts_min, english_waiver) come from Rollins pages. Admitted cohort about six to nine students a year. Deadline conflict flagged: the PhD page gives December 1, 2026, while the Rollins international page gives a May 1 preferred date for international students; the earlier date is used.
